short_description: Log sets, working weight, repetitions and actual recovery time with desk controls.
description: Log sets, working weight, repetitions and actual recovery time with desk controls. In setup, turn to change weight by 2.5 kg. Start switches the wheel between weight and reps. Click logs a set and starts its rest timer. Click again ends the rest and returns to setup. Hold the wheel to browse the last 20 sets. In history turn to browse, click to leave.
changelog: New screen transitions and high-contrast LED previews.
